applicability: Applies to integer parameters with depth>=0 and depth<=100000. Rejects non-integer or boolean inputs and negative depth. Does not handle non-uniform nesting or non-integer coefficients.
description: Evaluate nested expression outer_coefficient*(inner_constant+inner_coefficient*(...)) with depth nested layers. Start with innermost constant, iterate recurrence value=inner_constant+inner_coefficient*value depth times, multiply by outer_coefficient. Returns integer string. Uncertainty: assumes uniform nesting pattern and exact depth as given.
